description: JavaScript code for managing email recipient input fields in the SuiteCRM module 'AOR_Scheduled_Reports', including dynamic form manipulation and AJAX requests.

methods.name: show_emailField
methods.description: Displays or updates the email input field based on selected email type, making an AJAX request to fetch the input HTML.

methods.name: load_emailline
methods.description: Creates a new email line entry and initializes it with specified type and value.

methods.name: add_emailLine
methods.description: Adds a new email recipient input row to the email recipients table.

methods.name: clear_emailLine
methods.description: Removes a specific email input row from the table.

methods.name: clear_emailLines
methods.description: Removes all email input rows from the table.

methods.name: hideElem
methods.description: Hides a DOM element by setting its display to 'none' and clears its value.

methods.name: showElem
methods.description: Shows a DOM element by setting its display to '' (default).

methods.name: assign_field_change
methods.description: Adjusts visibility of related fields based on the selected value of a given field.
